scope: S124 interior and daily ambient: dungeon on-site observations and daily ambient remarks, CN/EN parity; no rewards, no task progress, no knowledge leaks
rules: 副本句只写现场观察，不替任何当事人发言，不揭未核真相
日常句只写本事件周边口气，不推进任务、不发物品
after 只改未来口气，不回滚旧结
与迹象、闲谈池不重复：同地点同事实只留一处

lines.cn: 水槽还在往下淌，桥面是后来搭的。
lines.en: The channel still runs; the walkway was added later.

lines.cn: 墓龛围着干台子，活人住过的地方比死人那边整齐。
lines.en: Niche walls ring the dry platform; where the living stayed is tidier than where the dead rest.

lines.cn: 检修梯通回泵房。别把唯一出口当备用。
lines.en: The service ladder leads back to the pump room. Never treat the only exit as a spare.

lines.cn: 桥断了，税栈没断。箱子照样过秤。
lines.en: The bridge broke; the tax shed did not. Crates still get weighed.

lines.cn: 箱号对不上脚印。混单就是这么来的。
lines.en: Crate numbers do not match the footprints. That is how one manifest swallows many.

lines.cn: 桥墩下有小路。走的人多了，就不是小路。
lines.en: There is a path under the pier. Enough walkers and it stops being a path.

lines.cn: 冷库先是保存点，后来才成了别的地方。
lines.en: The cold store began as a depot and only later became something else.

lines.cn: 病历夹在粮袋和封柜之间。放的位置就是答案。
lines.en: Case notes sit between grain sacks and sealed cabinets. Where they sit is the answer.

lines.cn: 门口的人只放你一次。下次得重新说。
lines.en: The man at the door lets you in once. Next time you explain again.

lines.cn: 空庭不说话。器材会。
lines.en: The empty court says nothing. The equipment does.

lines.cn: 墨迹要问时间和出处。问不清的，先别当真相。
lines.en: Ink marks must be asked when and from where. Unanswered, they are not yet truth.

lines.cn: 废弃设备不是真相机。带走的只有你核过的。
lines.en: Abandoned gear is no truth machine. Carry out only what you checked.

lines.cn: 编号完整，所以空名才像误差。
lines.en: The numbering is complete, which is why a blank name reads as a rounding error.

lines.cn: 授权、病例、粮袋各有去处，别放在一张单上核。
lines.en: Warrants, case notes and grain sacks each go somewhere; do not check them on one sheet.

lines.cn: 地窖的整齐是给人看的。看完就上来。
lines.en: The cellar is tidy for visitors. Look, then climb back up.

lines.cn: 管线是后建的。护理和控制不是同一套设计。
lines.en: The piping was added later. Care and control were never one design.

lines.cn: 出口开了不等于人都好了。照护才刚开始。
lines.en: An open door is not everyone healed. Care has only started.

lines.cn: 别把离开当痊愈。名单还在。
lines.en: Do not take leaving for recovering. The list remains.

lines.cn: 高处放资料，低处放人。顺序就是优先次序。
lines.en: Records up high, people down low. The order is the priority.

lines.cn: 水下的架子不是图书馆，是留置点。
lines.en: The submerged racks are not a library; they are a holding point.

lines.cn: 井口的风比井里冷。上来先晒一晒。
lines.en: The wind at the well mouth is colder than below. Dry off first.

lines.cn: 回声大，回声有限。别把感觉当结论。
lines.en: The echo is loud and bounded. Feeling is not a conclusion.

lines.cn: 机械台的读数错过一次。错的那次最像奇迹。
lines.en: The bench misread once. The wrong reading looked most like a miracle.

lines.cn: 能安全做到的很少。承认这一点再走。
lines.en: What can be done safely is little. Admit it, then walk out.

lines.cn: 外环能拆，内圈能退。退路先看。
lines.en: The outer ring can be dismantled and the inner one left. Check the way back first.

lines.cn: 装置有限，人有限。别让门替你决定。
lines.en: The device is finite and so are people. Do not let a door decide for you.

lines.cn: 先安全，再谈方案。顺序反了，什么都没了。
lines.en: Safety first, then terms. Reverse the order and nothing is left.

lines.cn: 车队欠桥工的工钱，旅店要交货。两头都是真账。
lines.en: The caravan owes the bridge crew and the inn owes a delivery. Both ledgers are real.

lines.cn: 粮约履行过以后，桥工的钱还没算完。
lines.en: The grain delivery was honoured; the crew's wages are still open.

lines.cn: 上游的菜田和营地都要水。谁都不是污染源。
lines.en: The vegetable plots and the camp both need water. Neither is the source of the trouble.

lines.cn: 水的事说开以后，桶还是各用各的。
lines.en: With the water matter aired, each still uses their own bucket.

lines.cn: 两家认同一枚工牌。一家要人，一家要给付。
lines.en: Two households claim one work tag. One wants the body, the other the payment.

lines.cn: 墓标立起来以后，名单还是三个人。
lines.en: The marker stands; the list still holds three names.

lines.cn: 地是佃农的，作物是流离者种的。
lines.en: The land belongs to an injured tenant; the crop was sown by the displaced.

lines.cn: 空地收完以后，地契和庄稼分开算。
lines.en: Once the clearing is harvested, the deed and the crop are reckoned apart.

lines.cn: 一批退热药，军民两边都订了。
lines.en: One batch of fever medicine, ordered by both the garrison and the town.

lines.cn: 药分完以后，单子还在两边手里。
lines.en: The medicine is split; both sides still hold their slips.

lines.cn: 躲的是雇主，找的人付过旅费。
lines.en: He hides from an employer; the one looking covered his fare.

lines.cn: 路标立好以后，路费和去留分开谈。
lines.en: With the signpost up, fare and whereabouts are discussed separately.

lines.cn: 箱主说保密，搬运的说刺激物泄漏。
lines.en: The owner calls it confidential; the handlers call it an irritant leak.

lines.cn: 箱子的事处理完，伤害记录单独留。
lines.en: The crate is settled; the harm record is kept apart.

lines.cn: 桥工要欠薪，赶药车的要通路。
lines.en: The bridge crew wants unpaid wages; the medicine cart wants a road.

lines.cn: 第二块板修好以后，工钱还没付清。
lines.en: The second plank is fixed; the wages are not.

lines.cn: 助手把乡民用法当自己发现。
lines.en: The assistant takes a village remedy for his own discovery.

lines.cn: 草指认过以后，来源和效果分开说。
lines.en: The herb is identified; source and effect are stated apart.

lines.cn: 守夜的想杀狼，肉商不认弃血。
lines.en: The watch wants the wolves killed; the butcher denies the dumped blood.

lines.cn: 夜岗安生以后，狼还在坡上。
lines.en: The night watch is quiet; the wolves are still on the slope.

lines.cn: 两柜互验记录，一方要匿名对照表。
lines.en: Two cabinets cross-check records; one side wants the anonymous table too.

lines.cn: 抄本交接过以后，对照表仍留在原柜。
lines.en: The copies changed hands; the table stayed in its cabinet.

lines.cn: 螺栓不是核心件，雇主说封存已完成。
lines.en: The bolt is not a core part, and the employer says sealing is done.

lines.cn: 检修做完以后，面子的事归面子。
lines.en: The maintenance is finished; face is face's own business.

lines.cn: 掌勺的先祷告再领饭。有人不愿被看见立场。
lines.en: The cook prays before serving. Some would rather not be seen taking a side.

lines.cn: 汤分完以后，站着的人还是站着。
lines.en: The pot is empty; those who stood aside still stand aside.

lines.cn: 有人用假牌找药，有人混卖假牌牟利。
lines.en: One uses a forged tag to find medicine; another sells forgeries for profit.

lines.cn: 假牌的事处理完，找药的人还得看诊。
lines.en: The forgeries are dealt with; the one seeking medicine still needs care.

lines.cn: 非核心排水费，被转给了不参加托管的村户。
lines.en: Non-core drainage costs were shifted onto households outside the trust.

lines.cn: 巡查做完了，维护费还得重新分。
lines.en: The inspection is done; the upkeep still has to be re-split.

lines.cn: 患者想停一项有副作用的照护，家属怕被说放弃。
lines.en: The patient wants one side-effect treatment stopped; the family fears being called quitters.

lines.cn: 照护方案改过以后，副作用记录留着。
lines.en: The care plan changed; the side-effect record stays.
